verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a SaaS CRM with public APIs could plausibly publish an OpenAPI spec. The evidence never shows a downloadable machine-readable spec. The probe found every standard OpenAPI/Swagger path on salesforce.com returning 404, and the platform page says only that Salesforce has APIs, with no spec artifact. Confidence is medium rather than high because the probe checked only the marketing domain, not a developer docs domain.
